response.text:
Journal 2245 has a 5300 debit of 6,631.24 and a 2000 credit of 6,622.24, so debits exceed credits by 9.00. The invoice amount is not shown, so I can't confirm directly which side is mistyped. The 2000 credit of 6,622.24 may be the typo, or the 5300 debit of 6,631.24 may be. The note that "expense debit does not equal AP credit" and the aggregate tie make a digit transposition (6,631.24 vs 6,622.24) the most likely cause.

I'll assume the invoice amount is the debit, 6,631.24, and that the AP credit was mistyped. The smallest fix that balances the journal group is a one-sided credit of 9.00 to 2000, which brings AP Control to 6,631.24. Journal 2245 is in period 8, which is closed, so the correcting line goes in open period 11. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.
